Deepfake Detective

Do you trust everything you see?

Welcome! AI can now copy a face, a voice, and a smile in minutes. Today you will step into the role of a deepfake detective and put your eyes to the test.

Note: how this challenge works

  1. You will watch two clips side by side. One is real and one is a deepfake.
  2. Choose the clip you believe is fake, then press Next.
  3. Answer 4 short questions about deepfakes and voice cloning.
  4. Get all 5 answers right to unlock one digit of your exit code. Any wrong answer can be retried at the end.
